title: Veterans Pension Recurring Income — Spouse's Social Security by Age of Its Benefit Level
content:
# Spouse's Social Security in the Veterans Pension recurring income

Where the Veterans Pension rate category counts spouse income, a spouse's Social Security figure is raised by the age of its own benefit level — the whole months from the date that level took effect, shown on the most recent spouse income report, to the redetermination of the recurring countable income:

- 24 or more whole months: by the two most recent December increases together, a multiplier of 1.0537;
- 12 to 23 whole months: by the most recent one, a multiplier of 1.028;
- under 12 whole months: not at all, a multiplier of 1.

The raised figure is rounded to the cent. The spouse's level is aged on its own date, independently of the veteran's.

### Points of judgement (hypothetical spouse figure 8000.00)

| Spouse's benefit level took effect | Figure counted |
|---|---|
| 11 whole months before | 8000.00 |
| 12 whole months before | 8224.00 |
| 24 whole months before | 8429.60 |
